comment: Jumps with the updated controls. 'default' is the arc measured in the original (tools/emu, hero leader slots 0-9 all gave the same): 14 ticks of 8 px = 112 px, ground height per tick below. 'speed' is the sideways speed of the jump as a multiple of the hero's walking speed (1.0 = exactly as fast as walking; the original's jump also moves at its walking pace, 8 px per tick). Per-hero entries override single fields; entries marked guess are not measured. 'climb' is the highest ledge in px the hero can jump up onto (the original's jump can climb three tiles = 48); walking never climbs a ledge in the updated controls. A jump with no landing place hops on the spot.

Tasslehoff.note: cluebook: Tasselhoff is too small to successfully jump rivers
